# Sean McConoughey

Canonical portfolio: https://smcconoughey.github.io/sean-mcconoughey-portfolio/
Last reviewed: 2026-09-26

Sean McConoughey is an aerospace engineering student at Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University and a test engineer. His long-term goal is to help lead launch control for human spaceflight. This is an aspiration, not a current job title.

Public work:
- ERPL ground-control software for waterflow and liquid-rocket static-fire tests, including telemetry, remote actuation, and automated sequencing. Sean served as ground controller on more than eight tests.
- Project leadership on an ERPL regeneratively cooled liquid-rocket engine. His analysis workflow enabled more than 1,000 design iterations and supported a move into fabrication. This engine has not yet fired.
- Leadership in ERPL, a student propulsion lab with about 180 members.
- Professional test-engineering experience in heavy industrial equipment and autonomous maritime systems. Employer-specific designs and data are intentionally omitted.

Public references:
- ERPL hot-fire coverage: https://news.erau.edu/headlines/hot-fire-test
- Embry-Riddle profile: https://erau.edu/hub-spoke/stories/launching-a-passion
- NASA Student Launch award coverage: https://sebsnjaesnews.rutgers.edu/2024/07/4-h-resistojets-rocketry-club-wins-altitude-award-in-2024-nasa-student-launch-competition/
